args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina Kroll, here's what I found for Kwame's account review. I read #coastal-team, #coastal-random and Moss's Coastal digests (plus your public Pellucid cutover note). The channels have nothing on either account. Everything comes from the notes.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)*
• Ticket #4419: open. `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length (Moss's Coastal cheat sheet, undated).
• Ticket #PD-8841: Pemberline Dock chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B (your 2025-12-08 note). I can't see its current status.
• Bug with no ticket number: CSV import on the Berth 2 yard map, still open as of your Dec 2025 note.
• Known friction, no ticket: chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change (cheat sheet).

*Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)*
• Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers (cheat sheet).
• Request with no ticket number: patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift (Moss's 2025-11-02 digest).
• Issue with no ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering supplied a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher (cheat sheet).

*Please check before the review*
• #4419 is inconsistent in Moss's notes. The cheat sheet puts it on PHL (the report timeout). The 2025-11-02 digest lists it as a barge slip 7 schedule sync under Kwame's port account, next to a Driftmoor request. I've kept it under PHL, but someone should confirm the account.
• I left out PD-4821 and #8812, which are Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark. I also left out PD-4824 and PD-4827, which are Saltmarsh.
• I haven't seen any ticket statuses beyond what's above. The notes are dated, and the most recent PHL/DMF items are from 2025.
